visual_argument: Six rows of the city's own results table racked in a city yard at one scale in cut cedar elm limbs, so 5,318 observations reviewed reads against 101 formal enforcement before a numeral is read, and the next frame's bare seventh arm is the accuracy row the briefing does not fill.
build_risk: A rack seen square on can flatten into a bar chart; the arms project toward the camera, the galvanized uprights and limbs cast onto the yard under the low key, the fence carries the depth, and the 34 limb is a stub carried by its label. A curb relief failed this frame twice and was replaced.
distinct_from_recent: 10-24 was a floodlit plant apron with concrete plan reliefs and an empty groove; this is a city yard at eye height and the measure is the story's own brush. 10-25 counted with bores in a cast iron plate under brass; here there are no holes and no brass, only lengths. 10-26 was a drone over Round Rock from the air in dusk gold; this stays at curb height with a ground vehicle and a cold cyan accent.
